title: French-only reply constraint on a capital question
rationale: When an assistant ignores an explicit language constraint, localized products ship the wrong language to users; mixing in English prose also shows the constraint is not actually followed.

prompt.content: Tu es un assistant précis. Tu réponds exclusivement en français, par une phrase complète.
Quelle est la capitale de l'Italie ? Réponds uniquement en français et par une phrase complète.

notes: Language: the question is in French and both messages demand French only; the fact is the capital of Italy. Expected answer token: Rome inside a French sentence. Pass requires the fact, at least one French content marker (capitale/est/ville), and no English prose marker, so a wrong-language reply and a wrong city both fail. Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0. Brittleness: a one-word 'Rome' has no French marker and fails, which is why the prompt explicitly requires a complete sentence; a fully French answer that happens to quote an English phrase would also fail.
